title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Quality Assurance Analyst**
The SAP Test Automation Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions using Selenium and REST APIs for SAP end-to-end (E2E) test scenarios, ensuring the delivery of high-quality software.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium and REST APIs for SAP E2E testing.
* Modify and enhance existing automation scripts based on changes in UI, business processes, and application requirements.
* Work closely with the Enterprise Business Analyst team to understand requirements and prepare the required test data.
* Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, automation practices, and overall software quality.
* Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams in an onsite-offshore delivery model.

Qualification
  
  

* BE/ME/MCA from a reputed institute.
* Minimum 4+ years of IT experience, including at least 3 years of experience as a Test Automation Developer/Engineer.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* Strong experience in SAP Test Automation, particularly SAP Fiori-based applications using REST APIs.
* Hands-on experience in developing and implementing Selenium-based test automation suites.
* Experience in developing test automation strategies and frameworks using Selenium and REST APIs.
* Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Test Automation concepts, methodologies, and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub and version control practices.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and effectively manage requirements.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with global counterparts.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to a broad spectrum of cloud-based technologies and solutions.
* Experience working in an onsite-offshore delivery model.
* Strong understanding of relevant technical and industry best practices in software testing and quality engineering.

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience with SAP Web GUI automation.
* Hands-on experience with Robot Framework.
* Exposure to modern test automation and quality engineering practices.

title: TC-CS-IAM-Tech BA-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Tech BA- Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-5 Years of expertise and strong understanding of end-to-end Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) capabilities and its processes, including Identity Lifecycle Management, Access Requests, Approvals, Access Reviews, RBAC, SoD, and Application Onboarding.
* Proven ability to gather, analyse, and document business and technical requirements, translating stakeholder needs into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and implementation-ready requirements.
* Hands-on experience in application onboarding, RBAC, SoD, compliance, and governance initiatives, ensuring alignment with security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and documentation skills, with the ability to independently lead workshops and discussions with application owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams for assessments, discovery, and requirements elicitation.
* Experience conducting IGA maturity assessments, current-state and future-state analysis, gap assessments, and providing strategic recommendations to improve governance, automation, and compliance.
* Ability to drive testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and adoption activities, ensuring successful implementation and business adoption of IGA solutions

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Kinaxis Lead Analyst
description:
Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software-defined future. Our state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. In 2024, we recorded annual sales of approximately $3.87 billion and secured $6.1 billion in new business.
  
  
Supports the growth and operations of the Kinaxis RapidResponse/Maestro platform within Global IT. Works alongside the Senior Kinaxis Consultant covering system configuration, integration support, testing, and day-to-day operations. Designed for a motivated professional with solid implementation experience ready to take on broader responsibilities
  
  

* Support end-to-end Kinaxis implementations — requirements, configuration, testing, and go-live.
* Build and maintain workbooks, dashboards, alerts, and data views.
* Assist in developing and maintaining data integration pipelines between Kinaxis and external systems (ERP, EDW).
* Monitor data loads and integration jobs; investigate and resolve data quality issues.
* Provide second-line technical support for Kinaxis issues raised by business users.
* Execute testing (unit, integration, UAT); document results and resolve defects.
* 5+ years hands-on Kinaxis Maestro; at least one full end-to-end implementation.
* BS/MS/PhD in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field.
* Practical experience building workbooks, dashboards, alerts, or data views.
* Working knowledge of data integration concepts and Kinaxis data feeds.
* Familiarity with SQL for troubleshooting and validation.
* Understanding of core supply chain planning concepts (demand, supply, inventory).
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts or service management practices (incident, change, problem).
* Kinaxis certification a plus; ERP exposure (SAP, QAD, IFS) and ETL experience welcome.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist | Night Shift (On-site Kolkata)
description:
Company Description

**Comparison Junction**
is a unified comparison and switching platform that helps customers find better-value deals across
**Energy, Telecom, Travel, Insurance, Banking, and other essential services**
.

With over a decade of experience in telesales, digital sales, and inbound customer acquisition, our teams help customers compare available options, understand their choices, and complete their switching journey with confidence.

Role Description

We are looking for a
**Quality Assurance Specialist**
with strong
**Call Centre and Sales Quality experience**
to join our team in
**New Town, Kolkata**
.

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be responsible for
**auditing customer interactions, ensuring compliance with process and client requirements, identifying quality gaps, and providing actionable feedback to improve customer experience and sales performance**
.

This is a hands-on quality role involving
**call auditing, BQ management, compliance checks, RCA, CAPA, reporting, coaching support, and client reporting**
.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of calls, analysing customer interactions, identifying root causes, and converting quality findings into measurable process and performance improvements.

Key Responsibilities
  
☎️ Call Auditing & Quality Monitoring

* Conduct regular
  **call audits**
  based on defined quality parameters, sampling methodology, and audit plans.
* Evaluate customer interactions for:
* Sales effectiveness
* Customer experience
* Communication quality
* Process adherence
* Product/process knowledge
* Objection handling
* Disclosure requirements
* Accuracy of information
* Compliance
* Closing and conversion practices
* Identify critical errors, behavioural gaps, process deviations, and missed sales opportunities.
* Maintain accurate and timely quality scores and audit records.
* Ensure consistency and objectivity in the evaluation process.

💬 Feedback & Coaching

* Provide
  **specific, actionable and timely feedback**
  to Sales Advisors and Team Leaders.
* Identify recurring behavioural and process gaps and recommend targeted coaching interventions.
* Support Team Leaders and Training teams with insights from call audits.
* Conduct calibration sessions to ensure consistent understanding and application of quality standards.
* Track whether corrective coaching results in sustained improvement.

📋 BQ Management

* Own and maintain the
  **BQ (Bad Quality) management process**
  .
* Identify and classify BQ cases based on defined quality and compliance criteria.
* Track BQ trends by
  **agent, team, process, campaign, error type, and root cause**
  .
* Ensure BQ cases are communicated to relevant stakeholders within defined TAT.
* Monitor corrective actions and recurrence of BQ.
* Provide regular BQ analysis to Operations and Management.

🛡️ Compliance & Process Audits

* Conduct compliance checks across customer interactions.
* Ensure advisors follow approved scripts, disclosures, sales processes, and regulatory/client requirements.
* Identify
  **critical compliance breaches**
  and escalate them immediately.
* Monitor adherence to client-specific quality requirements and SOPs.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails.
* Support internal and client audits when required.

🔎 RCA – Root Cause Analysis

* Conduct
  **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**
  for recurring quality, compliance, customer experience, and sales issues.
* Identify whether the root cause is related to:
* People
* Process
* Product
* Training
* Technology/System
* Communication
* Policy
* Leadership/management
* Use data and call evidence to validate the identified root cause.
* Distinguish between
  **symptoms and actual root causes**
  .
* Present RCA findings with clear evidence and recommended corrective actions.

🔧 CAPA – Corrective & Preventive Action

* Develop and track
  **CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action)**
  plans arising from quality and compliance findings.
* Define:
* Problem statement
* Root cause
* Corrective action
* Preventive action
* Owner
* Target date
* Success measure
* Track CAPA implementation and effectiveness.
* Conduct follow-up checks to confirm that issues have been permanently addressed.
* Escalate overdue or ineffective CAPAs to the relevant stakeholders.

📊 Reporting & MIS

Prepare and publish regular quality reports covering:

* Quality Score
* Audit Volume
* Pass/Fail Rate
* BQ Trends
* Critical Errors
* Compliance Performance
* Customer Experience Indicators
* Process Deviations
* Agent/Team Performance
* Repeat Errors
* RCA Trends
* CAPA Status
* Improvement Trends

Develop
**daily, weekly and monthly quality dashboards and reports**
for Operations and Management.

🤝 Client Reporting

* Prepare accurate and professional
  **client quality reports**
  .
* Provide quality insights, trends, observations, and corrective-action updates.
* Support client review meetings with relevant quality data.
* Respond to client quality queries and audit observations.
* Ensure client-specific quality and compliance requirements are accurately reflected in internal audits and reporting.
* Coordinate with Operations and Management to close client-identified quality gaps.

📈 Continuous Improvement

* Identify recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements.
* Analyse trends across teams, campaigns, products, and customer journeys.
* Identify opportunities to improve
  **customer experience, sales conversion, compliance, and process efficiency**
  .
* Participate in quality improvement projects and process reviews.
* Recommend changes to scripts, SOPs, training modules, and workflows based on quality insights.

Key Performance Areas

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be measured on:

* **Audit Accuracy & Completion**
* **Quality Score Accuracy**
* **BQ Identification & Reduction**
* **Compliance Adherence**
* **RCA Quality & Timeliness**
* **CAPA Closure & Effectiveness**
* **Repeat Error Reduction**
* **Feedback TAT & Quality**
* **Client Reporting Accuracy & TAT**
* **Quality Reporting & Data Accuracy**
* **Customer Experience Improvement**
* **Process Improvement Contribution**

Qualifications

* **5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Analyst roles within a Call Centre, Contact Centre, BPO, Telesales, or Sales environment.**
* **Mandatory experience in a sales/contact-centre environment.**
* Strong experience in
  **call auditing and quality monitoring**
  .
* Experience handling
  **BQ / Bad Quality management**
  .
* Good understanding of
  **sales processes, customer experience, compliance, and call-centre operations**
  .
* Experience conducting
  **RCA and CAPA**
  .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics and performance reporting.
* Proficiency in
  **MS Excel / Google Sheets and reporting tools**
  .
* Experience preparing
  **client-facing quality reports**
  is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable working in a
  **night-shift environment**
  .
* Bachelor's degree preferred.

What We Look For

We are looking for a QA professional who goes beyond
**"checking calls and giving scores."**

The right candidate should be able to connect:
**Call Finding → Customer Impact → Root Cause → Corrective Action → Preventive Action → Measurable Improvement**

You should be comfortable challenging processes, asking
**"Why did this happen?"**
, validating the root cause with evidence, and ensuring that corrective actions actually prevent recurrence.

Strong
**sales understanding**
is particularly important because the role requires evaluating not only compliance and customer experience but also
**sales conversations, objection handling, persuasion, and closing behaviour**
.

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)

* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)

**EY\- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role**

 **GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety \& Reliability)**
**Position Details**
 As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG\-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit\-for\-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no\-go decisions.
   

  

 You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk \& compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional \+ non\-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
   

  

 This is a core full\-time role that requires a hands\-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q\&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi\-step workflows.
* Translate business use\-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red\-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:
+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias \& fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:
+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding \& faithfulness (RAG\-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool\-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM\-as\-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:
+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):
+ Prompt injection (direct \+ indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial\-of\-service / denial\-of\-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre\-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:
+ tool misuse / over\-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least\-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high\-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision\-ready, including:
+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk\-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no\-go.


**Key Requirements/Skills \& Qualification:**
* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7\+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:
+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands\-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi\-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure\-by\-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse\-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical \+ non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast\-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Senior Consultant \- CPQ Transformation will support Configure, Price, Quote transformation initiatives within the Customer \- MSS practice. This role combines commercial process improvement, quote\-to\-cash process design, requirements structuring, solution support, and delivery coordination. You will work with client stakeholders to assess current\-state configuration, pricing, quoting, approval, and contract handoff processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support implementation of CPQ\-enabled workflows that improve sales productivity, pricing discipline, quote accuracy, cycle time, and revenue realization.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support CPQ transformation pursuits by contributing to proposals, RFP responses, client discussion materials, and solution narratives.
+ Conduct secondary research, benchmark analysis, and current\-state diagnostics to support CPQ modernization, quote\-to\-cash improvement, and commercial effectiveness offerings.
+ Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, playbooks, process templates, and point\-of\-view materials on CPQ transformation, pricing governance, and quote\-to\-cash enablement.
+ Support preparation of executive presentations, workshop materials, and client\-facing deliverables to communicate CPQ transformation opportunities and recommendations.
+ Keep abreast of CPQ platform capabilities, pricing automation, approval workflow trends, AI\-enabled quoting insights, and commercial operations practices that may affect client growth priorities.

* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Support CPQ transformation engagements from current\-state assessment through future\-state design, implementation planning, adoption support, and benefits tracking.
+ Assess product configuration, pricing, discounting, quoting, approval, proposal generation, contract handoff, order handoff, and quote\-to\-cash process performance to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Document business requirements, process flows, user stories, functional specifications, data needs, approval rules, and operational readiness considerations for CPQ\-enabled transformation initiatives.
+ Support design of CPQ workflows, product and pricing rules, guided selling journeys, approval hierarchies, quote templates, governance routines, and performance dashboards.
+ Work with sales, pricing, finance, legal, product, operations, technology, and data teams to translate commercial priorities into structured delivery inputs and implementation\-ready artefacts.
+ Support CPQ adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, training inputs, change impact documentation, communications support, UAT coordination, and adoption tracking.
+ Contribute to business cases and benefits models to quantify quote cycle time reduction, pricing compliance improvement, sales productivity gains, margin protection, error reduction, and revenue uplift.
+ Track project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions to support delivery excellence across scope, timeline, and quality expectations.

* Technology \& Innovation
+ Support teams in leveraging CPQ platforms, CRM systems, pricing tools, contract lifecycle management solutions, workflow automation, analytics, and AI\-enabled commercial insights.
+ Assist in defining data, integration, reporting, governance, and adoption considerations required for CPQ transformation and quote\-to\-cash enablement.
+ Identify opportunities to use templates, diagnostics, analytics, and automation to improve discovery, solution design, requirements readiness, testing support, and value tracking.
+ Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
+ Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of CPQ and revenue transformation capabilities, including operating model design, pricing governance, approval workflow optimization, guided selling, product catalog readiness, and quote\-to\-cash excellence.
* Have experience leveraging AI\-driven commercial insights, including quote recommendations, pricing and margin analytics, customer 360 views, and advanced sales performance reporting.
* Have exposure to leading CPQ, CRM, and revenue management platforms such as Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, Conga CPQ, and PROS.
* Bring experience across industries such as technology, professional services, manufacturing, industrial products, consumer products, healthcare, financial services, or other B2B sectors.


**What We Look For**
* 5\+ years of experience in CPQ transformation, quote\-to\-cash transformation, sales transformation, pricing operations, commercial excellence, revenue operations, or digital transformation.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Experience supporting CPQ\-enabled transformation programs, quote\-to\-cash process improvement, pricing and discounting workflow redesign, or commercial operations improvement projects.
* Strong understanding of product configuration, pricing rules, discount approvals, quote generation, proposal workflows, contract handoff, order handoff, and commercial performance metrics.
* Hands\-on exposure to CPQ platforms, CRM systems, pricing tools, workflow automation, reporting tools, or sales process redesign.
* Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder coordination, \& project management skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Specialist - Application Security
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Specialist \- Application Security
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32550**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* The Specialist in this position will plan and deliver web, API and mobile VAPT engagements within agreed scope, quality and timelines
* You will perform manual and automated testing; validate findings and eliminate false positives
* And rate vulnerabilities using OWASP, CWE and CVSS, considering exploitability and business impact
* Also, document reproducible evidence, proof\-of\-concept steps and practical remediation actions
* You will need to retest fixes, confirm closure and record residual risk or exceptions
* And maintain test cases, evidence, reports and engagement records in line with VAPT standards
* Lastly, escalate critical findings and delivery blockers promptly; support critical activities outside business hours when required


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* You must have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline
* And a CEH or relevant web\-security / scanner certification preferred
* Must have two to four (2–4\) years in application security or an enterprise security team
* And also, at least six months of hands\-on web, API or mobile security testing, including manual testing and scanner validation
* Must is knowledge with OWASP, WSTG, MAS, CWE and CVSS, Web, API and mobile black\-box/grey\-box testing
* You must also know Burp Suite, Qualys WAS/Acunetix, Kali Linux, Nmap and sqlmap, HTTP/S, REST APIs, authentication protocols, mobile controls and network fundamentals


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!

description:

 Kolkata, India

 (DEAI HV) Product

 R0137531
   

  

**Our Company**
 We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers \- from banks to theme parks \- can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate \- and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team \- and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data.
   

  

**The Team\- Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Development Test Engineering Senior Professional to join our dynamic team at Hitachi, Ltd. This role involves leading and executing complex testing strategies to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products and systems.
   

  

**The Role**
* Design, develop, and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for various software components and systems.
* Lead and mentor junior test engineers, providing technical guidance and fostering best practices in software quality assurance.
* Automate testing processes using various tools and frameworks, including developing and maintaining automated test suites.
* Perform functional, regression, performance, integration, and user acceptance testing across the software development lifecycle.
* Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with product management, development, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing scope.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methodologies, processes, and tools.
* Analyze test results, generate reports, and provide insightful feedback to improve product quality and development efficiency.
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging testing technologies, tools, and industry trends.
* Configure and troubleshoot networking infrastructure, including Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLANs, routing, and network security settings, to support integrated software, hardware, and industrial system testing.


**What You’ll Bring \- Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5\- 9 years of progressive experience in software development test engineering, with a strong focus on automation.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C\#, JavaScript) for test automation development.
* Extensive experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG).
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) and quality assurance principles.
* Experience with various testing types, including functional, non\-functional, API, and UI testing.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps) and test management tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, complex environment.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting network infrastructure, including managed switches, VLANs, TCP/IP networking, routing, and related connectivity technologies in development, test, or production environments.
* Experience with object storage technologies, data lake house architectures, and modern data platforms used to support analytics, machine learning, and AI\-driven solutions.
* Familiarity with AI/ML workflows, data engineering concepts, and validation of data pipelines, models, and AI\-enabled applications.


**About Us**
 We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
   

  

**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

**How We Look After You**
 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Technical Lead - VIM for SAP
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Technical Lead \- VIM for SAP
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32591**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Technical Lead in this position will be responsible for all solution components of the Vendor Invoice Management solution. And contribute to configuration, continuous improvements and standardizations of VIM solutions across SAP systems with the objective to optimize exception, approval and blocked invoice workflows and to increase efficiencies and to maximize the level of automation of the full end\-to\-end process.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* The Technical Lead will be responsible for handling the incident \& problem resolution (3rd level support) within defined SLAs and set priorities in close collaboration with Corporate IT and regional IT teams (2nd level support) and with business stakeholders in regions EMEA and APAC Regression testing \& regression test support during major releases and system upgrades
* And support the development of automated tests
* Also, gather and analyze business requirements, translate these requirements into functional and technical scope and functional specifications

* And coordinate the implementation of new VIM functionality in SAP ECC and S/4Hana Systems according to Linde plc project management guidelines
* You must contribute in knowledge transfer/guidance to and training preparation and delivery for IT and business stakeholders of new IT functionalities and IT solutions
* And collaborate and consult with business and IT teams or stakeholders and manage external service providers to deliver highly dependable, secure, and integrated solutions meeting compliance requirements to the business

 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?

* And Global Certification(s) in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions, S/4 Hana implementation experience required, ITIL Certification preferred
* A must is also 6\+ years of experience in technical design, implementation and support of international large\-scale systems in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (VIM), at a minimum experience in two end\-to\-end large scale VIM implementations.

* Knowledge on extensive skills in the implementation and optimization of Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (up to most up\-to\-date versions in SAP ECC and S/4Hana) and in the set\-up, administration and optimization of Invoice Capture for SAP
* Must is In\-depth knowledge of SAP and VIM standard functionalities with the aim to minimise programming


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.

 Synchrony’s
 **AML Engineering Organization** 
 is focused on building and maintaining technology solutions that help detect, monitor, and prevent financial crime across the enterprise.

You will work closely with cross\-functional teams including compliance, data science, and product management to build effective AML solutions that help detect and prevent financial crimes.

* Integrate AML product solutions with internal and external data sources, including sanctions lists, watchlists, and transaction data feeds.
* Continuously improve AML product performance through data analysis, tuning detection algorithms, and refining workflows.
* Work closely with data scientists and analysts to implement machine learning models and analytics for enhanced detection of suspicious activities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and swift resolution of AML product issues.
* Ensure AML product security, data privacy, and audit readiness.
* Support product QA, user acceptance testing (UAT), and participate in release management.
* Keep abreast of evolving AML regulations, industry trends, and emerging technologies to innovate product capabilities.
* Document system designs, processes, and code in accordance with company standards.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems.
* Minimum 3\+ years in software engineering with a focus on financial crime, AML, or regulatory technology products.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, or C\#.
* 2\-5 years of experience with AML software platforms (e.g., Actimize, SAS, NICE, or equivalent) is a must.
* Knowledge of AML regulatory requirements (e.g., BSA, FATF, OFAC sanctions) and risk typologies.
* Familiarity with transaction monitoring systems, alert workflows, case management, and KYC/CDD processes.
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), APIs, and integration of external data services.
* Understanding of machine learning/AI applications in AML is preferred.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Exposure to Actimize SAM and CDD modules.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities combined with a proactive and solution\-focused mindset.
* Ability to mentor and uplift the capabilities of peers in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment.
* Critical thinking, creativity, and a solution\-driven mindset
* Exposure to ETL tools like Ab initio.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 Minimum 4\+ years of experience with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems.
   

  

**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. title: Specialist - Global Trade System
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Specialist \- Global Trade System
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32838**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Specialist in this position will be offering the full scale of global functional SAP Global Trade System services to corporate and regional units around the globe. Also, provide support and define global trade processes, manage embargoes, and offers a solution for Denied Party Screening of Linde’s business partners.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* In this role, you will proactive consulting services based on industry practices leveraging previous project experiences in the SAP GTS areas as described (incl. e.g. user authorisations, reports, jobs, table structures, new functionality, system integration/interfaces)
* You will be part of Business projects and enhancements/continuous improvements lik analysis of user requirement received from customer/work effort estimation/create functional specification documenting the solution
* Create the functional solution design which includes SAP standard customizing as well as technical specifications delivered by the development team by using SAP SolMan as Change Management system
* And Perform unit testing, system integration\- \& functional (IT\-) testing
* Supporting customer during user acceptance testing and regression testing. Resolve defects identified during the testing cycles. Support cut over planning/execution and hyper care phase after go\-live
* Conducting workshops and training sessions to gather requirements and provide knowledge transfer
* You will be contributing to Incident Management / Service requests (3rd Level Support) incl. analyzing and resolving the reported issue
* Supporting to perform system upgrades, integrations, and testing


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Must have at least 3 years of experience in a SAP GTS solution based functional role.
* Academic degree in Business Administration or – Informatics or a certificated IT education min. 4\+ year professional experience in IT processes and ITIL
* Also, practical experience of IT Service Management Processes such as software change and/or release management or application management experience
* You must have the ability to debug SAP code to a certain extent to resolve low level incidents.
* Experience in SAP GTS Edition for Hana with debugging, integration knowledge with other SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Also, effective communication skills are required to influence stakeholders to achieve support and consistency of the overall IT strategies and policies, specifically in their own subject areas.
* Must have excellent analytical skills, together with the ability to think "outside the box".
* Foreign Trade Zone handling within GTS incl. Material balancing


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com

title: FS - RC - FSRM - QTB - MRM - AI - SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consulting QAS\- Quantitative Trading Book (QTB)**
**Profile: Senior Consultant \- Model Validator \- Generative AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
   

  

 EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large\-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* MRM (SR 11\-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
* Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
* Proficiency in the development / validation of state\-of\-the\-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.
* Utilize leading AI platforms like OpenAI, Azure GPT, Google Gemini, LLaMA, or Mistral, with proficiency in at least one platform.
* Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PySpark and PyTorch. Knowledge in AutoML tools which are used for automating the machine learning pipeline and Auto Kubernetes for managing containerized applications.
* Experience with cloud\-based platforms for building, training, and deploying machine learning models, such as AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud AI.
* Experience is writing validation reports as per MRM practices.


**What We Look For**
* Undergraduate (4\-year degree) or master’s or Ph.D. in Mathematics, Engineering, Computational Finance, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with hands\-on experience.
* Relevant certifications in AI/RAI from GARP/ Quantitative courses such as CQF.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions

title: Software Tester
description:
We're a small US software company. We build fast with AI\-assisted development, and we need one exceptional manual tester who finds what the automated tests miss. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role. You will be the first dedicated tester on the team, reporting to the founder.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Test new features and fixes before they reach customers: end\-to\-end workflows, edge cases, data imports, payments, permissions, and multi\-tenant isolation.
* Write bug reports a developer can reproduce in one read — steps, expected vs. actual, screenshots or video, severity, and what you think the cause is.
* Build and maintain the test checklist for each product area; keep a regression pass that runs before every release.
* Verify data migrations: source records vs. what the system shows, count by count, field by field.
* Communicate proactively. You'll tell the team what you're testing, what you found, and when you'll be online — before anyone asks.
* Push back. If something ships that you flagged, we want to hear about it.



  





**Must Have** 



* 3\+ years of manual / exploratory testing on a production web application, with references who can describe your work.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will write directly to engineers and occasionally read customer\-reported issues. This is assessed on the call and in your writing sample — please apply only if you're genuinely fluent.
* Experience testing financial software — payments, banking, lending, collections, or billing — where correctness is mandatory.
* Meticulous documentation habits. Show us a bug report you're proud of.
* **Flexibility. There is no set schedule. You'll work around the team's time tables — the founder, the implementation manager, and the engineer are in US time zones — and part of the job is live: reproducing a bug on a call, walking an engineer through what you found, joining a release check before it goes out. Some weeks that means early mornings IST, some weeks late nights. If you need a fixed shift, this isn't the role. What we ask in return is that you communicate — when you're available, when you're not, and what you found — clearly and without being chased.**



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* Time spent in a US debt\-collections or receivables BPO — as an agent, QA, or trainer. You'll understand the users on day one.
* Experience with SFTP file imports, CSV data mapping, or CRM systems.
* Basic SQL to check what's actually in a table.



  





**Compensation:** 
 monthly contractor rate, paid via a global payroll platform, negotiated on experience. A paid one\-week work trial on real test cases precedes any offer.
